notes.title: v1.1.0: New levels, Player stats, Halo Rank cap increase & more!
notes.content:
Competitors! It's time for another update.

In this update we are adding player statistics, difficulty scaling, Eliminations toggle, bumped max Halo Rank and new emotes. Read on for more details!

[h2]New Levels[/h2]

Today we have added [b]6 new challenging levels[/b] to the pool. We hope you enjoy them!

[b]Let It Rip[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748659/7460f19fa7404c7ed303a90b787e04e2bd795ea8.jpg[/img]

[b]Comb[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748659/46d6b1f969f89f13a42894572c4f6213900490b6.jpg[/img]

[b]Merry-Go-Round[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748659/439df576fcdba4515d256b552d9df9dbb9dbf111.jpg[/img]

[b]Hop Drop And Roll[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748659/b37458b32668e3c969e4be1f7a7d6206b51745a0.jpg[/img]

[b]The Raft[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748659/35a9f3a51765393fa44edaacc701be098a5d5275.jpg[/img]

[b]Beams Beyond[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748659/a0d093a8553be5f662aa269b7fce7ed20ccf0910.jpg[/img]

[h2]Progressive Difficulty[/h2]

Last month we ran a survey on our Discord server to determine how difficult the community finds each level. Based on this data, we have been able to add a feature to matches where earlier rounds will feature easier levels and later rounds will feature more difficult levels. 

When creating a custom game, you will also see the general difficulty indicator for each level so that you can pick the right selection of levels for your group. Green is "easiest" and red is hardest. You can also disable progressive difficulty in custom games using a new setting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748659/8f73e62f5ed05cddf0243bcec8812190911cb74f.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748659/62d144098e6b75456b3b275ac01a900e7bae538d.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748659/ec11038601e99e82f5ac03021f4e9a4d8871ce61.png[/img]

[h2]Player Statistics[/h2]

You can now go to your Customization screen and see your global player statistics. The data for these stats will start tracking from today onwards. We plan to implement Personal Bests here in the near future too so you can keep a track of your fastest times per level. Here are the stats we are adding for now:

[list]
[*]Games won
[*]Levels finished
[*]Win ratio
[*]Times jumped
[*]Metres travelled
[*]Jumps done
[*]Jump pads used
[*]Deaths by laser
[*]Deaths by falling
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748659/4ca02e8f598ee472269e6c355787a847c3039f62.png[/img]

[h2]Eliminations setting for custom games[/h2]

You can now disable Eliminations when creating custom games. This means even if you lose in a round, you will not spectate in the next one and will be able to play instead. On the final round, the first player to the end will still be deemed the winner. We hope this will make casual lobbies with your friends more enjoyable!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748659/e1bf9029e575820f66c930634a62a0396efa1453.gif[/img]

[h2]Halo Rank cap increased to 30[/h2]

The maximum Halo Rank has been increased to 30. Good luck winning those next Halos!

[h2]5 new emotes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Arm Wave
[*]Finger Gun
[*]Arm Stretch
[*]Double Thumbs Up
[*]Twist Dance
[/list]
[h2]Other changes in v1.1.0[/h2]
[list]
[*]The number of players current in-game is now shown on the server browser
[*]Fixed a bug where the next level might not load correctly in a custom game when a low number of levels are selected
[*]Ahead of the price adjustment for the game (see link below) we have dropped the prices for all characters
[/list]

For more details on what else we're working on, check out recent announcement: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2675290/view/6762787542907754089]Roadmap and upcoming price adjustment[/url].

notes.title: Roadmap and upcoming price adjustment
notes.content:
Competitors!

Firstly, thank you to everyone who’s supported LASERS since its release. We’ve really enjoyed seeing players having so much fun with the game!

[h2]Price Adjustment[/h2]

As you may already know, LASERS released on Steam as free-to-play. After much deliberation, we’ve decided to change this. From [b]February 29th at 10:00 AM PST[/b], LASERS will be priced at [b]$2.99[/b]. If you already own the game, you will not have to pay anything to continue playing.

The reason for this change is simple: although we’ve had a small, solid community of people downloading the game and purchasing the optional cosmetics, it’s simply not making enough profit to allow us to pay for the servers to run it, or our developers to keep supporting it. That said, we don’t want to abandon the game, because we believe in it, and would like to continue developing it.

[h2]2024 Roadmap[/h2]

We already have [b]6 new maps[/b] ready to go and will move them to the public beta branch in the next few weeks. Make sure to join our [url=https://discord.gg/cPpyR6tkHT]Discord server[/url] for further announcements regarding the beta release. For more planned new features, see below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748659/51b1285d1218fcc9c4b8d59744eff3a5679eeba1.jpg[/img]

We’ve been asked by many of you about the possibility of community map creation. We’ve thought this through, and are now considering Steam Workshop integration. Please note, this isn’t a certainty - it’s a large amount of work, but we’d really like to include the community in map creation somehow. We know lots of you will have great (and punishing..) level ideas!

Once again, thank you for your support since LASERS’ release. We hope the decision to charge a small amount for the game make sense, and we look forward to bringing you more laser-dodging, limb brutalising insanity in the near future!

notes.title: v1.0.7
notes.content:
[b]A word on difficulty[/b]

We made our game to be purposefully difficult. If you know our studio, we don’t make easy games. We are quite brutal with the challenges that we offer players. Our games aren’t for everyone! However, we do hope that you enjoy the challenge and over time you will most definitely be able to clear the maps consistently. 

However, we are aware that it can be frustrating to gain Halos because only 1 was awarded to the winning player. If you’re up against experienced players, or god forbid hackers, then this gets even more frustrating. To counter this, we are making some changes:

[list]
[*]Every player will receive 1 Halo for finishing any round
[*]Winners will receive 3 Halos for winning the final round
[*]The number of Halos for each rank has been increased to accommodate this
[*]You can now receive Halos from custom games (round time must be 3mins or less and all levels selected)
[/list]

You may lose a few of your ranks and we are really sorry about that but we wanted to make this correct before we bump the rank cap very soon. This is why we capped the max rank to 10 since launch as we wanted to be able to make adjustments if necessary with the least amount of rollback as possible. You can gain back ranks much easier now with this change.

[b]Public lobbies not starting[/b]

We’ve made a few changes to ensure that lobbies can get started even when there are AFKers / trolls in your game:

[list]
[*]As soon as 2 players go into the ready room, the timer will start
[*]If there is less than 6 players in the lobby, the timer starts at 120s
[*]If there are 6 or more players in the lobby, the timer will go to 60s
[*]If everyone in the lobby enters into the ready room, the timer will go to 5s
[/list]

We feel like this will give a good balance between ensuring games get started promptly but also allowing them to fill up when other players are online and searching.

[b]Other changes[/b]

[list]
[*]A system message is displayed in the chat with their time when a player finishes on each level 
[*]The timer won’t reset in the Lobby when new players enter
[*]Fixed an issue where kicked players would not be able to interact with the region picker after going back to Lobby
[*]Fixed an issue where the clock would not render if joining after the 60s timer had started
[*]Gangnam style emote loops smoother
[*]Prevents an issue where players could be considered finished when they hadn’t fully crossed the finish line yet
[*]Few fixes for the emote wheel interactions
[*]You can now rebind Q and E keys
[*]The word “prone” is no longer filtered by the profanity filter
[*]Server browser list items now scales better on different resolutions
[*]Number of halos shown to the winner at the end cutscene matches the format shown in the character selector screen
[/list]
